title: PokemonTCGPCard
description: A single card entry in the Pokemon TCG Pocket collection database.

card_name.description: Card name as shown in the app. Use 'unknown' if unreadable.

quantity.description: Number of copies owned, as shown in the app grid.

pokemon_type.description: Pokemon energy type. Use None for Trainer cards.

stage.description: Evolution stage. Use None for non-Pokemon cards.

hp.description: HP value if visible and applicable, otherwise null.

is_ex.description: True if this is an ex card.

rarity.description: Rarity symbol or label as visible on the card. Use 'unknown' if not visible.

set_or_pack.description: Set or pack name if visible. Use 'unknown' if not visible.

variant_notes.description: Free-text notes distinguishing this card from same-name variants.

source_screenshot.description: Filename of the screenshot this card was extracted from.

source_row.description: Row position in the app grid (1-indexed). Null if unknown.

source_column.description: Column position in the app grid (1-indexed). Null if unknown.

needs_review.description: True if this card requires human review before the database is considered final.

review_reason.description: Required non-empty explanation when needs_review is true.
